# Moonday Live

> Ever wonder why today feels different? The Moon's 2.5-day cycle shapes your emotional climate. Moonday Live helps you discover your moon sign — free — with personalized blueprints, daily forecasts, and rituals across Mind, Soul, and Body. For entertainment and reflection.
